text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...My dad told me you were lacking
motivation
lately.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
Well, he lied. What's it got to do with
you
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Quite a lot actually. A student of mine
has a
worried look on her face—like
she's scared she'll
lose something
important to her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—you're afraid of what will
happen if
you run your hardest. You're
afraid of losing the
outlet you've come
to treasure.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. You've gotten really strong.
None of
the kids in class can even
compete with you
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What you want is proof that you're alive.
You
want your heart to skip a beat, to
pound. You
want that thrill that only
comes in a fleeting
moment.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're worried, isn't it? You
think that
maybe racing can't provide
that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
But you're wrong. You haven't even
experienced
your first official race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Festa. Don't you worry about a thing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I know you'll find what you seek at
Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And you'll meet people who will truly
satisfy that
burning desire in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I promise. You'll feel alive at Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Don't run away from finding your answer.
You
have to give it at least one try.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm alive, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Because you set me down the right path.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I can hear the blood flowing through my
head.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(It's the same as always... That's how I
know.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (My destination...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll follow you to its completion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll follow you to its completion.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (...is my gamble.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there's something I need to say.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So long as there's an "all" in "all or
nothing," and
a "return" in "risk and
return—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Then I'm going to go for it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Festa? Trainer? Why have you come
back?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Teach. You told me before that hope
keeps
people alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna make hope something you
can't ever
run away from.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Live, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If this year is all you have left, I'll spend
the rest
of that time becoming your ray
of hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So don't say things like you "wish" you
could
watch me. You have to say you
"want" to, that
you're "going" to.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'll be running in the Classic
Triple
Crown in a way you've never seen
before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blow everyone's minds with
my skill.
That way, they'll direct their
hopes at me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And once I win the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe,
everyone will be able to find
hope.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Even you, Teach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Let's take a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna toss a coin right here in front
of you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We won't know the results until I open
my hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna know the results, you'll
have to look
with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The moment I open my hand is the
moment I take
on the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And the desire you have to see where
the coin
lands is called "hope."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, though, saying that hope
keeps people
alive is just a bunch of
crap. It's not like Teach's
condition can
magically up and disappear.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But there's no helping anyone who
decides to just
give up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And my goal's to win the Triple
Crown
tour...
choice_data_list: For that to happen, we need to give them something to hope for.
For that to happen, we need to give them something to hope for.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like things went according to your
plan
after all. I can't really afford to take
things easy
accumulating experience
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown tour is a can't-miss
event. Those
who can't watch the races
the day they happen
can always tune in
to TV programs airing
recordings later
on.
choice_data_list: You'll have to perform well enough to get plenty of TV time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if she performs well in
the race,
word should reach her teacher
in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey... Don't read too far ahead. It's unnerving.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You dummy.
choice_data_list: Could you tell me I've become more dependable?
Could you tell me I've become more dependable?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back and do some training, if
you want
to feel so reliable.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You gotta make me into an Umamusume

everyone wants to bet their hopes on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple Crown
is the
Satsuki Sho.
